description.en-US: Chesterton's exposition of distributism: some general ideas, some aspects of big business, of the land and of machinery, a note on emigration, and a summary. A plea for the widest possible distribution of property against both capitalism and socialism, from the Catholic social tradition.
description.pt-BR: A exposição de Chesterton do distributismo: algumas ideias gerais, alguns aspectos da grande empresa, da terra e da maquinaria, uma nota sobre a emigração e um resumo. Um apelo à mais ampla distribuição possível da propriedade contra o capitalismo e o socialismo, na tradição social católica.

sources.edition: The Outline of Sanity (London: Methuen, 1926), Internet Archive full-text OCR (theoutlineofsanity).
sources.description: Six parts as printed; the numbered subsections inside each part are not marked off. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Chesterton died in 1936 and the book was published in 1926, so it is public domain.
